body:
More on Psionic Elemental, Small from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Psionic Elemental, Elder", "Psionic Elemental, Greater", "Psionic Elemental, Huge", "Psionic Elemental, Large", "Psionic Elemental, Medium" but are not part of the Psionic Elemental, Small entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Psionic Elemental, Elder

hp 152 (16d10+64)
Fort +9; Ref +18; Will +14; reroll Will save 1/day
Defensive Abilities warp reality; DR 10/magic; Immune elemental traits; PR 22

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +22 (2d8+7)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Psi-like Abilities (ML 16th):

At-will—body equilibrium, brain lock (all targets, DC 17*), concussion blast (four targets, 4d6*), detect psionics, distract (DC 16), clairvoyant sense, control light, control sound, ectoplasmic form, empty mind (+8 Will bonus*), precognition, psionic charm* (all targets, 16 days, DC 21), psionic levitate, psionic suggestion* (seven targets, DC 17), read thoughts (DC 17), synesthete, telekinetic force (525 lb., DC 18*), telekinetic thrust* (525 lb., DC 18), psionic teleport, trace teleport
3/day—energy ray (ML 12th, 12d6, DC 16*), mental barrier (ML20th, 12 rounds, +5 AC*), mind thrust (ML 10th, 10d10, DC 20*), psychic crush (6d6, DC 16**)
1/day—ego whip (4d4 Cha, DC 20*), energy burst (16d6, DC 23*)

**Psychic crush includes the +4 Will save adjustment described in the power.
